what: The 31B's first wiring check (atlas_build.py wiring_check, the night of 28-29 October 2026) and the offline scoring that read it again at each reader's own operating point: every figure ARCHITECTURE §4.7, ROADMAP §vi, README, COMPUTE, the details tab, LINK_MODEL / LINK_MODEL_USE and the scientist's prompt quote from it, with its value and the script and output that give it.
kept: 29 October 2026, copied from the session scratchpad, before it is cleared. The scripts are the session's own, their paths moved to this folder (outputs) and atlas_data/offline/wiring_check_31b (inputs); each starts with a two-line note saying so. scripts/stored_summary.py was written afterwards, to read the check file's own summary, cost and sign counts. z1_log.txt, z4_log.txt and nonzero.json are the session's own outputs (a rerun of nonzero.py gave the same bytes); every other output was written again on the CPU from the kept inputs on 29 October 2026, and z2_per.npy, z3_per.npy and validate_31b_per.npy are identical to the session's (allow_pickle: they hold dicts of per-layer lists). gpu_logs/ holds the GPU runs' own logs: the passages pass, the wiring rebuilt, and the check (layer 45 first, then the other 58).
how: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= /home/eric/bin/ai/theodolite2/.venv/bin/python -I scripts/<name>.py > outputs/<name>.out (nonzero.py takes the check file as its argument). z1 and z4 run Gemma-4-31B on the CPU (THEODOLITE_DEVICE=cpu, the packed checkpoint, the reference unpacker, at 22 torch threads on the 12-core, 24-thread CPU); the rest read the kept arrays only.

wiring_check.npz.note: a copy of atlas_data/index/wiring_check.npz as the GPU run wrote it (built_at 2026-10-29T05:23:53Z, 00:23 CDT), pinned here because `wiring_check --fresh` will set that file aside and write another

z1_out/q0-3.npz.what: each census question's unpushed gate and up values (g0, u0) and activation at every layer, last word-piece in float32 and every word-piece in float16, from z1

z4_out/L5,L20,L35,L50.npz.what: six of the check's writers a layer pushed by +-0.25 and +-1 of their ceiling on the first question, every later layer's gate, up and activation at the last word-piece, from z4

inputs.flat.npz, standin_rows.npy, run_closed/,: the investigation's flattened arrays (scripts/investigation/flatten.py) and its stand-in runs; regenerable, kept for completeness
inputs.orig_*.npy: the session's own z2_per.npy, z3_per.npy and validate_31b's per-layer values, to compare the rewritten ones with
inputs.passages: a6_passages.py reads atlas_data/index/passages.d itself (built_at 2026-10-29T04:46:21Z, 23:46 CDT on 28 October); it is not copied
inputs.workflow_cli_index/: the stand-in index the wiring workflow's CLI dry run built (workflow_logs/cli_index.log)
